name: Shrink Chaturanga package, drop dead code, raise Lighthouse
Shrink Chaturanga installers, drop dead code and images, raise Lighthouse

description: Baseline measure died in Lighthouse before a score existed. --preset=mobile is not a lighthouse preset (choices: perf, experimental, desktop). Partial package scan also triple-counted Electron framework symlinks (package_bytes 840MB vs zip 112MB).

asi.hypothesis: The measure script can package the mac arm64 app and report a baseline score
asi.rollback_reason: lighthouse CLI rejected --preset=mobile; no score was emitted
asi.next_action_hint: Drop --preset for the mobile run (mobile is the default). Measure package bytes with lstat so framework symlinks are not followed. Do not treat the 840MB figure as the baseline.

description: Harness fix measured a real 285MB app and 112MB zip with no Stockfish, but Lighthouse rejected the Electron file:// URL (INVALID_URL) after marketing scored 99–100.

asi.hypothesis: Symlink-safe package bytes plus default mobile Lighthouse preset produce a baseline score
asi.rollback_reason: Lighthouse INVALID_URL on the Electron renderer file:// URL; score.mjs never ran
asi.next_action_hint: Audit the production renderer over http (same out/renderer files). Do not use the 840MB figure. Marketing mins so far: perf 99, a11y 100, bp 96, seo 100. Biggest size lever remains electronLanguages en (~49MB locales).

description: All seven page audits and the package scan finished, but score.mjs dropped lh_a11y because its metric regex rejected digits.

asi.hypothesis: HTTP audits of the production renderer complete a baseline score
asi.rollback_reason: METRIC name regex [a-z_]+ does not match lh_a11y
asi.next_action_hint: Regex is now [a-z0-9_]+. Exclude scripts/piece-svg-sources from unreferenced images; the generator walks that directory. Then rerun for the baseline. Observed: package_bytes 285364805, zip 112446644, locales 49229173, stockfish 0, lh min perf 71 a11y 100 bp 96 seo 90, knip 122.

description: Score script finally ran, but the audit was a browser static server and lint failed on unused harness imports. Desktop pages must be measured in the packaged app, not a browser.

asi.hypothesis: Fixed metric parsing yields a keepable baseline
asi.rollback_reason: checks.sh lint failed on unused .auto imports, and the desktop scores came from a browser static server. The user requires Lighthouse in the desktop app build only.
asi.next_action_hint: Launch the packaged Electron app, attach Lighthouse to its debugging port, and navigate hash routes inside that app. Drop the browser static-server audit. Fix unused imports so oxlint passes.

description: Packaged app launched and the onboarding snapshot ran, but route reloads reported NO_FCP because the window was not painting.

asi.hypothesis: Lighthouse attached to the packaged Electron app can score its routes
asi.rollback_reason: NO_FCP on in-app navigation; window was occluded and backgroundThrottling stays on unless CHATURANGA_E2E_BACKGROUND=1
asi.next_action_hint: Drive the packaged app the way e2e does: background hook, occluded-window flags, CDP focus emulation, page.reload inside the electron page. Do not fall back to a browser.

description: Packaged-app onboarding audit returned, then Skip setup click used a handle from before the reload and the page context was gone.

asi.hypothesis: Background paint hook lets packaged-app Lighthouse finish every route
asi.rollback_reason: Skip setup element handle was taken before the onboarding reload, so click failed with DOM.describeNode context gone
asi.next_action_hint: Re-query Skip setup after the onboarding audit. Stay on the packaged binary. file:// best-practices will include is-on-https; do not switch the audit to a browser to hide that.

description: Baseline of the packaged macOS app. Stockfish is not bundled. Lighthouse is the Electron binary; file:// zeros performance and best-practices (no paint metric, is-on-https).

asi.hypothesis: A packaged-app Lighthouse run can establish a baseline score
asi.learned: 49MB of Electron lproj ships. file:// audits fail is-on-https, bf-cache, robots-txt, meta-description, color-contrast. Do not move the audit to a browser to hide protocol failures. Next size cut is electronLanguages en plus en-US so Windows pak names still match.

description: English-only Electron locales cut the app from 285MB to 237MB and the zip from 112MB to 101MB. Lighthouse matched the baseline, then profile cleanup threw ENOTEMPTY and hid the score.

asi.hypothesis: electronLanguages en+en-US drops non-English lproj without changing Lighthouse or checks
asi.rollback_reason: rmSync of the throwaway profile threw ENOTEMPTY after a successful audit, so score.mjs never ran
asi.next_action_hint: Cleanup must not fail the measure. Re-apply electronLanguages [en, en-US] and keep if package_bytes stays near 236625143 and lh_pages stays 6.

description: Ship only English Electron locales (en and en-US). Unpacked app 285MB to 237MB, zip 112MB to 101MB. Lighthouse unchanged.

asi.hypothesis: electronLanguages en+en-US drops non-English lproj without hurting the packaged app
asi.learned: Mac keeps en.lproj (570KB). Zip fell 11.7MB, unpacked 48.7MB. en-US is listed so Windows locale paks are not deleted. Do not drop en-US.

description: Stop shipping a second copy of the macOS icon. The bundle already has icon.icns; the window falls back to that, then the png.

asi.hypothesis: extraResources app-icon.icns duplicates the bundle icon.icns
asi.learned: Removed 423496 unpacked bytes and 381KB from the zip. Dock icon is still electron-builder's icon.icns. Do not delete app-icon.png; Windows and Linux use it.

description: Deleted unused icon sources and added a meta description. SEO rose 82 to 91, but the description added 196 bytes and the score got worse.

asi.hypothesis: Unused icon sources and a renderer meta description improve the score
asi.rollback_reason: package_bytes rose 196 bytes, crossing two 100-byte score units, which outweighed the SEO gain and the dead-image drop
asi.next_action_hint: Delete only the unreferenced iconset and white-on-black png so package_bytes stays flat. Revisit the meta description only alongside a larger size cut.

description: Remove the unreferenced iconset and white-on-black icon. They were not in the package. Dead-image count is now zero.

asi.hypothesis: Deleting unreferenced icon sources drops dead_units without growing the package
asi.learned: package_bytes unchanged, unreferenced_images 11 to 0. Meta description still not worth 196 bytes under the 100-byte score step. icon.icns source iconset is gone; the built icns remains.

description: Brightened caption text to pass WCAG on dark surfaces. Packaged Lighthouse contrast score did not move.

asi.hypothesis: fg-subtle #727982 is the color-contrast failure on every packaged page
asi.rollback_reason: a11y stayed 95 and color-contrast still failed after the token change; score unchanged
asi.next_action_hint: Contrast failure is not the base fg-subtle token, or it is flaky under glass. Do not keep guessing colors. Next: knip ignoreExportsUsedInFile so in-file exports are not counted as dead, then delete symbols that are unused even in their file.

description: Dead exports dropped knip from 122 to 1, but lint failed: unused glass snapshot state and a let that should be const.

asi.hypothesis: Removing exports nothing imports, and not counting in-file exports as dead, clears knip
asi.rollback_reason: oxlint: window-glass current is unused after the hook went away; importWorkers must be const
asi.next_action_hint: Re-apply the deletions, drop the unused current variable, and change importWorkers to const. Then find the last knip issue.

description: Remove exports nothing imports. Knip is clean once in-file exports and false-positive deps are not counted as dead.

asi.hypothesis: Symbols knip says nothing imports are dead and can be deleted without growing the package
asi.learned: knip_issues 122 to 0. package_bytes unchanged. Remaining Lighthouse failures on file:// are protocol limits plus color-contrast and label-content-name-mismatch that did not move when fg-subtle was brightened. Further Electron framework cuts (swiftshader, icu) would risk the board.
